      Everything each plan includes

      How billing works

      Transparent down to the last cent.

      Your bill has up to three parts. We explain each one so you know exactly what you pay, to whom and why, before you start.

      1

      Kontaro plan

      Paid to Kontaro

      • A fixed monthly price including users, features and AI conversations.
      • No setup fee and no contract. Cancel anytime.
      • Local taxes may apply depending on your country and payment method.
      2

      WhatsApp fees

      Charged by Meta

      • Meta charges per delivered message, based on the message type and the recipient's country.
      • Messages your customers send you are always free.
      • Meta's official rates with no Kontaro markup. Depending on how your number is connected, you pay Meta directly or it appears on your invoice at cost.
      3

      Artificial intelligence

      No per-token billing

      • You don't pay for tokens or need an OpenAI, Anthropic or Google account: AI costs are included in your plan.
      • We count conversations, not words: each customer the AI helps within 24 hours counts once, however many messages you exchange.
      • Reached your limit? The AI pauses and chats go to your team. Extra packs (1,000 conversations for US$25) only if you want them.
      4

      No surprises

      Our promise

      • Kontaro never charges anything beyond your plan without your confirmation.
      • Before each campaign, you see how many people it will reach and Meta's estimated cost.

      FAQ

      Frequently asked questions

      Do I need a developer to get started?

      No. Connecting is guided screen by screen, and the AI learns from what you already have: website, catalog, spreadsheets and PDFs. Most businesses are answering customers the same afternoon.

      Could my number get banned?

      Kontaro runs on Meta's official API, not on unofficial apps, which are the main cause of bans. Campaigns only go out with WhatsApp-approved templates, and anyone who asks to leave a list stops receiving right away.

      Can the AI say something wrong?

      It only answers from what you taught it, and you test everything before going live. When it doesn't know, it tells the customer and hands the chat to your team with a summary.

      How much does it cost, and what's billed separately?

      Your plan has a fixed monthly price with AI included. Separately, there are only the fees Meta charges per delivered message (service replies, notifications and campaigns), at Meta's official rates with no Kontaro markup, plus any taxes in your country. Messages customers send you are free. Use the calculator in the pricing section to estimate.

      Why does Meta charge for replies to customers?

      Since October 1, 2026, Meta also charges for replies sent within the 24-hour window (service messages), at the country's utility rate. They used to be free. Kontaro shows these costs clearly so there are no surprises.

      How does the free trial work?

      You get 14 days with the Growth plan features, no credit card needed. At the end, you choose a plan. Nothing is charged automatically.

      Is there a contract? Can I cancel anytime?

      No contract and no cancellation fee. Cancel whenever you want, and export your contacts and conversations before you go.

      I have my own system. Can I integrate it?

      Yes. The Kontaro API sends messages and receives replies from any system, and webhooks report every delivery and reply.
